fields.description: Enter one Vobiz caller ID / DID per line. You can also separate numbers with commas. These numbers will appear as selectable Vobiz Numbers in User Mapping.
fields.label: Caller IDs

fields.description: Legacy default caller ID. Use Caller IDs above and select a Vobiz Number on each user mapping.
fields.label: Default Caller ID

fields.description: Optional public HTTPS site URL for Vobiz callbacks. Leave blank to use the current Frappe site URL.
fields.label: Webhook Base URL

fields.description: Optional secret token for inbound DID callbacks. If set, add this token to the Vobiz inbound Answer URL.
fields.label: Inbound Callback Token

fields.description: One DocType per line. A mapped user can call only from these DocTypes and only when they already have read access to the document.
fields.label: Allowed DocTypes

fields.description: Customer First dials the customer before bridging the mapped user. Agent First dials the mapped user before bridging the customer.
fields.label: Default Call Flow

fields.description: When enabled, incoming calls from an existing CRM Lead are routed to the current Lead Owner before the agent who last called. Treat-as-new statuses always take priority.
fields.label: Prefer Current Lead Assignment for Incoming Calls

fields.description: One manual post-call disposition per line.
fields.label: Manual Disposition Options

fields.description: When enabled, inbound callbacks are finally routed to the End Fallback Mobile if mapped agents do not answer.
fields.label: Enable End Fallback

fields.description: When enabled, inbound customer callbacks are routed to this number after the last agent and all fallback agents are busy or unavailable.
fields.label: Enable Busy Callback AI Fallback

fields.description: Prevents calls to numbers listed in Vobiz Blocked Number or source records marked Do Not Call.
fields.label: Prevent Blocked Numbers

fields.description: When enabled, normal agent users are automatically marked Offline after no CRM activity for the configured time. Team Leaders and Admin / Manager users are excluded.
fields.label: Enable Idle Auto Offline

fields.description: No-activity timeout in minutes for normal agents.
fields.label: Idle Auto Offline Minutes

fields.description: 0 means no daily limit per reference document.
fields.label: Max Attempts Per Record Per Day

fields.description: 0 means no daily limit per mapped user.
fields.label: Max Calls Per User Per Day

fields.description: Allows manual and scheduled CDR backfill from Vobiz.
fields.label: Enable CDR Sync

fields.description: Stereo separates call legs for easier review and AI evaluation where Vobiz supports it.
fields.label: Record Channel Type

fields.description: Requests Vobiz automated transcription for recorded calls.
fields.label: Enable Transcription

fields.description: Runs AI disposition after a transcript is received.
fields.label: Enable AI Disposition

fields.description: Optional app-level key. If blank, site_config openai_api_key or vobiz_openai_api_key is used.
fields.label: OpenAI API Key

fields.description: AI results below this confidence are marked for manual review.
